rules: Source identity is checked against the actual build input copies.
Changed/unchanged is relative to ledger baseline, not target certification.
Only current rerun checks enter the registered coverage; overlapping ranges counted once.
Instruction/operand equivalence is separate from raw byte equality and startup integration.
Older ad-hoc evidence outside this registry is unregistered, not proof of zero recovery.
No whole-product percentage until the target coverage registry is complete.

code_block_progress.denominator_status: Target code/data/overlay classification not yet complete.
code_block_progress.interpretation: Verified instruction blocks with checked linked operands; not final file identity or integrated functionality.
code_block_progress.counting_rule: Union of verified target intervals; no duplicate credit for overlapping blocks.
code_block_progress.percentage_rule: 100*A/C only after the full target code universe is established; unmapped code stays in C.

same_offset_comparison.interpretation: Raw byte agreement, not semantic or source-authenticity completion; no alignment or relocation normalization.

open_gates.remaining: Wire post-move startup and relocated vectors; Move_res_data remains uncalled.
